rolling_shutter.reconstruction_check: reconstruct threshold aggregate and compare with the retained aggregate key

on_chain_adapter.standard: EIP-712-style typed-data digest with canonical ECDSA recovery
on_chain_adapter.security_boundary: The off-chain attester must run native Shutter share and signature checks before signing. The Solidity adapter verifies the attestation, not the BLS share equation itself.

non_claims: No direct BLS12-381 verification is claimed on Gnosis EVM.
A valid attestation does not establish that a real Keyper is willing to join an offer.
The adapter is an executable experimental boundary, not an audited production deployment.
